sources.snippet: The new model can transcribe speech in real time, identify and separate more than 20 speakers in recordings lasting over an hour, and handle conversations in which speakers switch between languages.

sources.title: AI4Bharat, Bodhan AI Build 1.2 Bn Parameter Speech Model for 26 Indian ...
sources.snippet: AI4Bharat and Bodhan AI have developed Indic-Transcribe, a 1.2-billion-parameter speech recognition model trained on 1.3 million hours of audio to transcribe speech across 26 Indian languages and English.
